title: FIDA HOON US PAY SALAAMI HAI JIS KA NAAM HUSSAIN
body:
FIDA HOON US PAY SALAAMI HAI JIS KA NAAM HUSSAIN
MERA MUHEEN MERA AAQHA MERA IMAAM HUSSAIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
SABAA KO BHEJ KAY ROUZAY PAY KAR RAHA HOON-DUA
KARAIN QUBOOL ILAAHI MERA SALAAM HUSSAIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
JO KARBALA KI ZAMEEN PAR HUVA THA UNKA WUROOD
THO PHIR KAY DEKHTAY THAY QABR KA MUQAAM HUSSAIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
SUNA NA HAAYE KISI SANGH DIL NE LAAKH KAHA
RASOOL KA HOON NAWAASA HAI MERA NAAM HUSSAIN.
<<DIVIDER>>
NA POOCHHO WAQT WOH KAISA THA JAB MADINAY SAY
CHALEY HAR EK KA LETHAY HUVEY SALAAM HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
PANAH LEYTAY THAY DUSHMAN AJAL KAY DAAMAN MEIN
JO WAAR KARTHAY THAY LEKAR ALI KA NAAM HUSSAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
MERI KUCH AUR TAMANNA NAHIN HAI AYE AASIF
YEH AARZU HAI BANALAY MUJHEY GHULAM HUSSAIN
